items.resolution: E1: Empty question shows labelled validation; timeline/answer render the exact empty copy above; no fake run/answer.
items.probe: What is shown when there is no data — zero items, an unfilled form, or absent media?

items.resolution: E1: Pending create/run/reconnect/cancel states have text status; active form/examples prevent duplicate submission; cancellation remains available until terminal. Details remain readable.
items.probe: What is shown while data or content is still loading (skeleton, spinner, progressive reveal)?

items.resolution: E1: Create/network/protocol/domain/cancel failures have separate fixed copy and explicit retry path. Received steps are retained on interrupted transport; no success is inferred without a valid terminal.
items.probe: What is shown when the load or submit fails (message, retry affordance, partial fallback)?

items.resolution: E1: Invalid input retains typed content; partial streams retain accepted steps; an answer is provisional until completion. An absent citation never becomes a fake source.
items.probe: What is shown for partial or incomplete data — some fields or rows present, others missing?

items.resolution: E1: At 360px all cards/controls/quotes/IDs wrap without page overflow; long answers expand vertically; only textarea editing may scroll internally.
items.probe: What happens when content exceeds its container — scroll, clip, wrap, or truncate?

items.resolution: E1: Question is bounded to 2048; accepted protocol content keeps its declared frame bounds; long words and IDs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; action labels wrap and retain a 48px target.
items.probe: What happens with unusually long text — truncation, wrapping, ellipsis, or reflow?
